usages.explain: This expression has the same meaning as 「といったら」. Used in casual speech, it conveys the speaker's attitude of familiarity, teasing, criticism, worry, etc., towards a person brought up as the subject. It is mainly used by women and children.

examples.content: ケントったら、女の子の前で赤くなってるわ。
examples.transcription: けんとったら、おんなのこのまえであかくなってるわ。
examples.mean: Kent turns red in front of the girl.

examples.content: 美智子ったら、どうしたのかしら。いくら呼んでも返事がないけど。
examples.transcription: みちこったら、どうしたのかしら。いくらよんでもへんじがないけど。
examples.mean: I wonder what Michiko would have done. No matter how many times I call, there is no answer.

examples.content: お兄さんったら。ちゃんと話を聞いてよ。
examples.transcription: おにいさんったら。ちゃんとはなしをきいてよ。
examples.mean: If you have an older brother. Please listen carefully.

title: ったら => speaking of; I told you already; come on (annoyance / dissatisfaction)
